source.snippet: I'm in search of a Rust sources generator for Open API yaml spec files, to generate models and the Rust server structure, if possible. Until today, I used the OpenAPI generator. But even its latest version 7.22.0 faces troubles, either with its rust_server or rest-axum generator, producing models whose structs or collections sometimes doesn't comply to a trait that a validator will refer later to.

problem_statement: Rust developers using OpenAPI spec files cannot reliably generate correct, trait-compliant server code; the dominant tool (OpenAPI Generator) produces broken Rust output with known unresolved issues, leaving teams with no production-ready alternative.
target_segment: Rust backend developers building REST APIs from OpenAPI specs, in small-to-mid-size engineering teams
notes: Known open bug in a widely-used generator with no clear fix. A dedicated, well-maintained Rust OpenAPI server codegen tool (especially axum-focused) could capture this demand.
